newTerms.faither / faithers: hombre de fe / hombres de fe

forcedChoices.reason: «traslación» is the glossary form for Adjuster-fusion translation; here 'translated' means carried over from one level to another.

forcedChoices.choice: la explicación del paso del sentido del deber ... a esa fe
forcedChoices.reason: Avoids «traslación», which the glossary reserves for the technical sense.
The general 'you' reads better as an impersonal form.
«toma de conciencia de la conciencia» is redundant; «realización» keeps the sense of making real.
The English 'even as yourself' is general; an impersonal form avoids choosing tú or ustedes.
English 'realization' can mean 'becoming real' or 'becoming aware'; Spanish cannot hold both, and «realización» fits the parallel with science best.

forcedChoices.choice: tú in «¿Cómo sabes tú que yo no sé?»
forcedChoices.reason: One believer answers one doubter; the rule for one person is tú.
Keeps the bankruptcy image of 'refunding its current objections'; «corrientes» avoids the false friend «actuales».
Agrees with «una realidad no cualificada, un absoluto»; the nearest head noun is «realidad».
